name: vam-ai-units
description: Vasyl Marchenko's personal AI units — knowledge-base and session-continuity skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: vam-knowledge
plugins.description: Personal knowledge base worked as a loop: bootstrap and repair the vault contract, read prior notes before re-solving a problem, write durable grounded notes, garden the vault as it decays, and map unfamiliar codebases level by level. Vault-agnostic — pair it with one or more vam-vault-* connectors.

plugins.name: vam-session
plugins.description: Session continuity — compact a conversation into a handoff document a fresh session, another agent, or a teammate can pick up cold.

plugins.name: vam-vault-kb
plugins.description: Vault connector — mounts the primary knowledge vault as the obsidian-kb MCP server, reading its path from ${VAM_VAULT_KB}.
